source_notes: Reference-source check: request #307 supplies only an encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com thumbnail URL, without an original publication link or artist credit. This is the submitter decision, not maintainer acceptance or rights clearance; maintainer review of the unresolved attribution remains required before merge. Sprite pixels were generated with the built-in image_gen tool, followed by native-alpha extraction, whole-pose retiling for spacing, and deterministic shared-scale V2 assembly.
